title: Vi Mode Freezes
body:
Vi Mode freezes. I have to close the terminal instance and open a new one.

Two things worth noting in my current setup:
- The mentioned issue occurs intermittently
- The mentioned issue occurs only when alacrity is launched using the shortcut, never when launched from the command line
- I use https://github.com/jeffreytse/zsh-vi-mode, perhaps this is causing contention?

### System

OS: Linux
Version: alacritty 0.13.0-dev (33306142)
X11, ubuntu:GNOME, GNOME Shell

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
If this happens specifically when running something inside the shell, what makes you think it's an Alacritty issue?

Does selection still work? If so, it's  not Alacritty.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: Selection doesn't work.

comments.author: participant2
comments.body: I'd assume you select with the mouse and not by other means and you're talking about vi mode from alacritty on `ctrl + shift + space` (by default).

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: If mouse selection doesn't work while holding shift, then Alacritty might actually be frozen. In that case a gdb backtrace would be helpful.

comments.author: participant3
comments.body:
I'm launching `alacritty` via an i3 shortcut:

```
# start a terminal
bindsym $mod+t exec alacritty
```

Then inside the terminal I launch a command, for example `toggl now`, which writes to `stdout`.

I hit `CTRL + SHIFT + SPACE`, `hjkl` keys don't work and hitting the shortcut does not exit the VI mode - `alacritty` is stuck. I must kill the process, otherwise I am not able to use the terminal.

Mouse selection does not work either - text gets selected, but I can't seem to be able to copy it.

It does not happen each time, but quite often :/

comments.author: participant2
comments.body: if you run alacritty with `--print-events` does it stuck?

comments.author: participant2
comments.body: Besides, obtaining a backtrace from freeze with gdb could help, though, you should build yourself with `cargo run --release` and attach to that process once it freezes.

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
Process with the INSTALL.md and build alacritty yourself. Then you run it with `cargo run --release` and try to repro your issue (cargo is rust's package manager, should come with rust package on your system).

Then once it freezes, you should run `gdb -p <PID>`(requires root), it'll attach to the process and you should obtain backtrace with `bt full`, there could be multiple threads, so you should do that for each thread and look around to figure out the place it blocks.

From your log it blocks inside the winit though, would be nice to know where.

comments.author: participant2
comments.body: Oh, so it froze on `swap_buffers` and you trace was a bit wrong. Sounds like a driver bug? When it freezes after `RedrawRequested` could you provide a trace from all threads?

comments.author: participant3
comments.body: I'll have a look at that (btw I've updated my trace to include only hjkl presses. Before it contained other events).

comments.author: participant2
comments.body: It looks like you just stop getting keyboard events? Is resize freezing? Like if you run something like `htop` inside of it and try to resize, does it update?

comments.author: participant3
comments.body:
Yeah, I can confirm that running `htop` and resizing the window using `i3` works correctly, as `htop` redraws its TUI.

When I run `htop,` then enter visual mode and `alacritty` freezes, `htop` beneath still updates to reflect the current usage.

comments.author: participant2
comments.body: so it's not freezing, you just don't get key events. Could you change the hotkey to enter Vi mode to `Ctrl + Esc`? I think maybe you trigger some global hotkey and it breaks something, you don't actually have a freeze it seems.

comments.author: participant4
comments.body:
Had the same problem too.

`CTRL+SHIFT+Space` (Vi Mode) occasionally prevents new events from entering.
To reproduce: Just enter and exit Vi Mode repeatedly. :<nick>: 

I don't know much about Alacritty internally, but taking a look, it seems that the origin of this "freeze" is when pass `false` to `set_ime_allowed` inside of `toggle_vi_mode` of `/alacritty/src/event.rs`.


But, when passing `true` (or not making this `set_ime_allowed` call)...
[/alacritty/src/event.rs](https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty/blob/c0c267d60e1b877d5c2c76893751d13547a233c4/alacritty/src/event.rs#L870)
```rs
// self.window().set_ime_allowed(was_in_vi_mode);
self.window().set_ime_allowed(true);
```
... everything works perfectly.
But, I really don't know the impacts of making this call with `true` hardcoded.

Interesting: Not calling `set_ime_allowed` also solves the problem.

Running on X11.

comments.author: participant3
comments.body: I can confirm that @participant4 's proposed solution works for me.

comments.author: participant2
comments.body: We can't pass `true` on all platforms, because you'll basically be stuck with IME input if you have it on-going. I'd assume you all use ibus?
